title: TestTheEvacuationFlushesInFlightWorkAndWritesTheCheckpoint failed once under load: reproduce and fix
description: From #68 (2026-09-27): it failed once under -parallel load, with the evacuation output not reporting the attempt-branch push. It was not reproduced in 48 reruns. The suspected cause, the evacuation's branch push racing the supervisor's identical push for the ref lock, got a fallback that is unconfirmed. Flaky means bug: force the interleaving deterministically (block the supervisor's push at the ref lock), confirm or refute the race, and fix the real cause.
notes: 2026-10-07 18:06 - ticfac run epic-t8u: fn8 try 1 (run dispatch #7) merged into epic/t8u as 9a34b1001b74; the integrated gate (go, ts) passed.
acceptance_criteria: The interleaving is reproduced deterministically in a test, the cause is confirmed, and the fix makes that test pass
